item.title: Team Winters run ends at U18 Canadian Curling Championship in Timmins

item.description: But North Bay students and faculty worry that post-secondary education will continue to become more unaffordable

item.title: North Bay police confirm deceased man was missing man "Pierre"
item.description: North Bay Police Service extends its deepest condolences to Pierre’s family, friends, and loved ones.

item.description: Powassan wins the season series with French River 8-0 and now trail third-place Timmins by three points with a game in hand
